summary: Iteration 16: Tested new auth features (no email verification), password validation, admin dashboard, admin sidebar, and BNPS chapters. Found and fixed critical Sparkles is not defined bug in Sidebar.jsx. Also found auth.py has entire old code duplicated after new code (lines 370-851). Backend 100% pass. Frontend mostly working after Sparkles fix.

critical.issue: ENTIRE OLD CODE DUPLICATED: auth.py has the original implementation appended after the new implementation (lines 370-851). Both @router.post('/auth/register'), @router.post('/auth/login'), @router.get('/auth/schools'), @router.post('/auth/logout'), @router.get('/auth/me'), etc. registered TWICE. FastAPI uses first match so new behavior works, but file is 851 lines vs should be ~200 lines. Creates maintainability risk and potential confusion.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Sparkles icon used at line 152 but NOT imported from lucide-react (line 4). Caused ReferenceError: Sparkles is not defined, crashing the entire app for all logged-in users. Fixed by adding Sparkles to import statement.

issues: Grade requests show 'Class → Class' with empty values (blank old_class and new_class). Possible issue: grade change requests created via /users/class endpoint don't store old/new class values properly in some cases.

action_items: CRITICAL: Clean up auth.py - remove duplicate old code (lines 370-851). The file has the entire original implementation appended after the new implementation. Only keep lines 1-361.
Verify grade change requests store old_class and new_class values properly (admin dashboard shows 'Class → Class' with blank values)
Consider adding Skip button to onboarding wizard for returning users (still blocks UI on BNPS student login)
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: Entire old implementation duplicated (lines 370-851) after new implementation (lines 1-361). Both register and login routes registered twice. This is a HIGH maintenance risk - must be cleaned up.

auth.py lines 416-491: Old register implementation still creates users with is_verified=False and sends verification email. While FastAPI first-match means the new behavior (line 102-161) runs, the duplicate is confusing.
Sidebar.jsx: Missing Sparkles import was a crash-level bug affecting all logged-in users (FIXED in this iteration)

rca_of_sparkles_bug.root_cause: When admin link was added to Sidebar.jsx, a new Upgrade CTA button using Sparkles icon from lucide-react was added but Sparkles was not added to the import statement on line 4.
rca_of_sparkles_bug.impact: All logged-in users hit ReferenceError crash - entire app non-functional when sidebar renders.
rca_of_sparkles_bug.fix: Added Sparkles to lucide-react import on line 4 of Sidebar.jsx.
rca_of_sparkles_bug.rca_of_auth_duplicate: auth.py was modified by appending new code at the top of the file, but the old code was never removed. The file now contains two complete implementations. FastAPI path routing uses first-registered route so new no-verification behavior wins, but this is fragile.
